rules: module assignments enable functionality for ordinary users
role actions do not block operations
active super_admin bypasses assignment/action permissions and has global data visibility
ordinary users remain within owner or explicitly shared collaborator data scopes
missing module redirects navigation home and blocks direct HTTP access
human confirmation, resource integrity and actor attribution remain mandatory

http_modules.boundary: real Nest routing, guards and use case; synthetic token/session/database boundaries

http_invoices.scope: aliases, modules, no role action, authentication, observation ownership, validation and one synthetic principal inference

exercised_guarantees: direct navigation waits for context before mounting the protected page or its data queries
ordinary module access succeeds without roles/actions; superadministrator access succeeds without assignments
HTTP aliases, shared selector lists, unknown controller families and database failure are classified explicitly
SQL scope construction precedes pagination/export and groups OR predicates without widening ownership
source and destination ownership, mixed bulk rejection and inherited transactional managers
invoice upload preflight, file namespace and signed URL privacy
preview and cached result/receipt reauthorization, collaborator revocation and resource reparenting
own historical receipts survive deletion while the original business remains authorized
limitations: PostgreSQL execution/locks/concurrency of the new queries have not been verified against a real engine in this task: host Linux Docker daemon and local PostgreSQL binaries are unavailable.
Disposable SQL harnesses are prepared, not represented as passed.
No authenticated browser acceptance of an adopted candidate, real provider inference or production deployment.
Navigation caches do not provide push revocation; HTTP authority is rechecked. Invalidate auth:context:* when adopting.
New knowledge revisions remain draft/unregistered and require explicit publication review; approved historical documents and approval hashes were preserved.
Previously delivered signed URLs retain their native expiry; immediate revocation is not promised.
